scripts.build:domain: pnpm --filter @minions/core exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/testkit exec tsc -b --force
scripts.build:integration: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @minions/core exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/adapters exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/testkit exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/daemon run build
scripts.gate:lint: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm deadcode && pnpm generate:check && pnpm proto:lint && pnpm proto:breaking
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:integration && vitest run apps packages test/unit --passWithNoTests
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p .storybook/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter @minions/ui-kit run build && pnpm --filter @minions/web run build && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:integration && pnpm --filter @minions/ui-kit run build && pnpm --filter @minions/web run build && playwright test -c playwright-e2e.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.verify:pr: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm deadcode && pnpm generate:check && pnpm proto:lint && pnpm proto:breaking && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:visual && pnpm test:e2e
